technique.name: Mercy Is Not Forgiveness
technique.description: Immediately attacks all enemies within a set range. After entering battle, deals Lightning DMG equal to 50% of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a 100% base chance to inflict Shock equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate on every enemy target for 2 turn(s).

basic.name: Midnight Tumult
basic.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Kafka's ATK to a single enemy.

talent.name: Gentle but Cruel
talent.description_template: After Kafka's teammate uses an attack on an enemy target, Kafka immediately launches Follow-Up ATK  and deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Kafka's ATK to the primary target, with a 100% base chance  to inflict Shock equivalent to that applied by her Ultimate to the attacked enemy target, lasting for 2 turns. This effect can be triggered up to 2 time(s), with 1 use(s) recovered at the end of Kafka's turn.

skill.name: Caressing Moonlight
skill.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Kafka's ATK to one designated enemy and Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling2}}% of Kafka's ATK to their adjacent units. If the designated enemy or their adjacent target(s) is currently receiving DoT, all DoTs currently placed on that enemy immediately produce DMG equal to {{scaling3}}% or {{scaling4}}% of their original DMG.

ultimate.name: Twilight Trill
ultimate.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Kafka's ATK to all enemies, with a 100% base chance  for attacked enemy targets to become Shocked and immediately take DMG from their current DoT debuff(s), equal to {{scaling2}}% of its original DMG. Shock lasts for 2 turn(s). While Shocked, enemy targets receive Lightning DoT equal to {{scaling3}}% of Kafka's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

2.name: Torture
2.description: When an ally target's Effect Hit Rate is 75% or more, Kafka increases the target's ATK by 100%.

4.name: Plunder
4.description: If an enemy is defeated while Shocked, Kafka additionally regenerates 5 Energy.

6.name: Thorns
6.description: After using Ultimate, restores the triggerable count of Talent's Follow-Up ATK  by 1. And the Talent's  Follow-Up ATK  can cause all DoTs debuffs currently on the target to immediately produce DMG equal to 80% of the original DMG.

eidolons.name: Da Capo
eidolons.description: When using an attack, has a 100% base chance to increase the DoT taken by the target by 30% for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Fortississimo
eidolons.description: While Kafka is on the field, DoT dealt by all allies increases by 33%.

eidolons.name: Capriccio
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Recitativo
eidolons.description: When an enemy target takes DMG from the Shock status inflicted by Kafka, Kafka additionally regenerates 2 Energy.

eidolons.name: Doloroso
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Leggiero
eidolons.description: The Shock state inflicted on the enemy target by the Ultimate, Technique, or the Talent-triggered Follow-Up ATK has a DMG multiplier increase of 156% and lasts 1 turn(s) longer.
